stem: If \(6x - 13 = 29\), what is the value of \(x\)?

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of subtracting 13 from 29 instead of adding it: \(6x = 16\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the value of \(6x\), not \(x\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of dividing 42 by 3 instead of by 6.

verify:
x = symbols('x')
s = solve(Eq(6*x - 13, 29), x)[0]
assert s == 7
assert value(choices[answer]) == s
assert all(value(choices[k]) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
